args.title: Fix Malformed row error on trailing blank line
args.body:
File: src/ingest/parser.ts

In parseStatement, handle the case where the input ends with an extra blank line properly to prevent assertShape from throwing a 'Malformed row' error on the last row. This change ensures that trailing blank lines do not result in an unexpected malformed row error.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/parser.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The parser fails by throwing a 'Malformed row' error on the last row when the input file ends with an extra blank line. This happens because parseStatement removes the final empty line, but assertShape still checks and rejects the row beyond expected data.
